title: Canonical pullback on shifted etale derived Hom
statement: Let $S,T,Y$ be schemes, $A$ a commutative ring, $f:T\to S$, $g:Y\to T$, and $h:Y\to S$ with $h=f\circ g$ (in Lean, `h = g ≫ f`). Use the ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For $P,Q\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, define $H_f^n(P,Q)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)}(f^*P,f^*Q[n])$. Let $c_P:h^*P\xrightarrow{\sim}g^*f^*P$ be the canonical derived composition comparison obtained by deriving the inverse-image composition isomorphism. Define the pullback $H_f^n(P,Q)\to H_h^n(P,Q)$ by $a\mapsto c_P;g^*(a);s_n;(c_Q^{-1})[n]$, where $s_n:g^*(f^*Q[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^*f^*Q)[n]$ is the exact functor shift comparison and semicolons denote composition in traversal order. No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is needed to define these objects or maps.
